pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpaṃ pi odanaṃ pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpaṃ pi odanaṃ pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpaṃ pi odanaṃ pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave sūpaṃ pi odanaṃ pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.14: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.16.1: na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.17: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.2: gilānapucchakā bhikkhū gilāne bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.3: kacc' āvuso khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.4: pubbe mayaṃ āvuso sūpaṃ pi odanaṃ pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjāma, tena no phāsu hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.6: bhagavatā paṭikkhittan ti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema, tena no na phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā sūpaṃ pi odanaṃ pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.9: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.10.1: na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.11: na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilānena attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.12: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
